the_window_is_wider_than_the_batch.consequence: A delta taken across that window cannot be attributed to the batch without bisection. Three of the four regressions are already present at 0cf76ed, the batch's own branch point.

method.stage_bisection: The four regressed documents converted and scored on the real path at each of 0cf76ed (branch point), d7f0583 (stage 1), 89e023a (stage 2), ee30c99 (stage 3). parse_pdfium.py restored per commit with `git checkout`, never by shell redirection.
method.commit_scan: Then the same four documents at each converter-touching commit in f02d701..0cf76ed, checking out the whole `exactdoc/` tree per commit and holding `testkit/` FIXED at current, so only converter changes vary and the instrument does not move underneath the comparison.
method.validation: The method is sensitive: 02_research_paper does move between 0cf76ed and d7f0583, and x04's two endpoints reproduce the -05 and -05b numbers exactly.

c7_code.pdf.mechanism: All five MAJOR dimensions move at one commit, the one that gives a dropped glyph a position. raster_frac appearing from zero and live_text_cov leaving 1.0 is that commit's own subject: ink the text page could not decode is now emitted, so some of the page stops being live text. The batch's three commits do not move any of the five.
c7_code.pdf.reproduces_the_record: doc_recall, word_recall, live_text_cov, dy_p50 and raster_frac match the -05 `was` and the -05b `now` values EXACTLY on both sides.

x04_lo_tables_plain.pdf.reproduces_the_record: within2pt 0.2333 -> 0.1004 is exactly the regression the record reports, and both endpoints reproduce to four decimals.

x11_chrome_toc_headings.pdf._note: within2pt (0.0052), word_recall (0.3465) and dy_p50 (46.6) are unchanged across every commit measured, including the whole batch. The better -> minor verdict rides on the three dimensions above.

02_research_paper.pdf._note: This is the one the batch owns, and the stage-1 record already flagged its IR movement (74 -> 63 blocks, 23 -> 22 Paras) as a reported movement rather than a waived one.

the_fix.site: exactdoc/parse_pdfium.py, _pitch_reference, new `columnar` argument supplied by _build_blocks_one from its own col_xs
the_fix.rule: The CONSTANT fallback (PITCH_DEFAULT_EM * size) is taken only on a page where a gutter was actually found. A surviving page-wide measurement is still taken either way, because that is a measurement rather than a guess.
the_fix.why_this_is_the_right_condition: When the guard was written _column_split returned at most one gutter and usually none, so a collapsed reference on a gutterless page was overwhelmingly an undetected column and the guess was well-founded. Stages 2 and 3 then made detection succeed -- y06 went from 35 to 78 pages with gutters -- so the residual gutterless population is no longer that, and the guess no longer has its premise.

measured_populations._note: 4,132 floor firings instrumented in place across the gated 16 and the y family.

other_gated_unmoved._note: which is why they neither gained nor regressed, and why they still do not move under the fix

the_fix.what_the_joins_looked_like: Traced rather than inferred. On 02_research_paper the floor joined pairs of consecutive lines that ARE the same paragraph -- 'by drafting tokens with a small model and verifying them' + 'with a large one...' -- so the IR moved toward the reference (74 -> 63 blocks against a reference of 45) while the render moved away from it. A guess good enough to improve the IR is not good enough to reflow the page. That asymmetry is the finding.

tests._note: 552 plus 5. One existing test had to change: it asserted the constant fires on a single-column polluted page, which is exactly the behaviour being withdrawn. It now builds column evidence for the firing case, and a new test pins the refusal.

c7_within2pt_absolute_level._note: The direction, the transition commit and the other four dimensions all reproduce exactly; only this dimension's absolute level differs. `testkit/harness.py` changed inside the same window (b0762a2), which is the obvious suspect, but x04's within2pt reproduces to four decimals at BOTH endpoints under the same harness, so the harness is not a sufficient explanation and the residue is more likely a render difference specific to c7. Recorded as unresolved rather than explained away; it does not affect the attribution, which rests on the four dimensions that do reproduce.

instrument_caveats: The commit scan holds testkit/ fixed at current and varies only exactdoc/. That isolates converter changes by construction, and it is why absolute levels here need not equal the -05 record's, which was scored by the harness of its own day.

Floor firings were instrumented by wrapping _pitch_reference, _build_blocks_one and _build_blocks in place, so the gutter count attributed to each firing is the one assembly actually used, including the stage-3 projection fallback that lives above _column_split.
